name: val-broadcast-tool
description: VALORANT match lookup UI for graphics broadcast production. HenrikDev / Riot API / tracker.gg.

scripts.setup:tracker: npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.tracker:reset: node -e "import('./browser.js').then(m=>m.makeTrackerBrowser({}).resetProfile()).then(ok=>console.log(ok?'Browser profile cleared.':'Could not clear the profile - close any running browser and retry.'))"

comment: No required dependencies. Playwright is optional and only used by the tracker.gg source - skip it with 'npm install --omit=optional'.
